integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a locked wide shot frames a dark, snow-covered arctic landscape under a star-filled night sky. A military jet streaks across the upper frame at high altitude, its engine glowing. The afterburner ignites, throwing a brilliant blue-white cone of flame. The exhaust trail expands and twists behind the aircraft, ionizing the thin upper atmosphere — the plume shimmers, shifting from orange-white at its core to luminous green and violet at its edges, mimicking an aurora. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the glowing trail as it spreads into a vast, rippling curtain of man-made polar light, curtains of green and magenta undulating across the sky, faintly reflected on the snow below as the jet vanishes into the distance. Cold color grade, high contrast, volumetric glow, realistic exhaust dispersal at altitude.

overall_soundscape: A deep, distant jet-engine roar reverberates across the frozen silence, gradually fading as the aircraft recedes. A faint low atmospheric hum persists beneath the wind sweeping over the snow.

non_diegetic_music: Sustained low synth pads at a slow tempo, slowly swelling with shimmering high overtones that mirror the expanding light, then gently fading out.
